clue.text: Unending help by one Umbrian town

indicators.note: unending says the synonym for help loses its final letter

parts.note: to help is to assist
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone offers endless assistance to a single town in Umbria.
explanation.definitionFit: Assisi is a hill town in the Umbrian region of Italy, home of St Francis.

clue.text: French department where he finally demolished cedar

indicators.note: finally says the pronoun comes at the end of the answer
demolished says the letters of cedar are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: In some French region a man ended up felling a cedar tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Ardeche is a department in south-eastern France named after the river Ardeche.

clue.text: Trains not diverted to Highland village in its element?

indicators.note: diverted suggests the letters of the two words are sent on a different route

explanation.surface: Railway services fail to be rerouted to a Scottish village.
explanation.walkthrough: The element strontium was named after Strontian in the Scottish Highlands, where its ore was found.
explanation.definitionFit: Strontian is a Highland village whose name was given to the metallic element strontium.

clue.text: Upsetting report about some French land

indicators.note: about says the turned word goes around the French article
upsetting in a down clue turns the synonym for report upside down

parts.note: news is a report
de is French for some or of

explanation.surface: Distressing news concerning a bit of French territory.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweden is a Scandinavian country, so a land in the sense of nation.

clue.text: Dutch port going down the pan

explanation.surface: A Dutch harbour is apparently headed for the toilet.
explanation.walkthrough: Flushing is the English name for Vlissingen in the Netherlands; 'going down the pan' means being flushed away down a toilet.
explanation.definitionFit: Flushing is the old English name of Vlissingen, a Zeeland seaport; flushing also describes water carrying waste down a lavatory.

clue.text: No golf in former capital of Asian country

indicators.note: no says the letter for golf is absent from the old capital

parts.note: Lagos was the capital of Nigeria until Abuja replaced it
G is golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Golf courses are missing in an Asian country's former capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Laos is a landlocked country in South-East Asia.

clue.text: Town in Picardy is held by mediocre partners

indicators.note: held by says the word is sits inside the synonym for mediocre

parts.note: so-so means mediocre
N and S, North and South, are partners at bridge

explanation.surface: A northern French town is run by indifferent business partners.
explanation.definitionFit: Soissons is a historic town in the Aisne department, part of the Picardy region of France.

clue.text: Tailless bird from South Africa on one of the Balearics

indicators.note: tailless drops the final letter of the bird

parts.note: the ibis is a long-billed wading bird
ZA is the international code for South Africa

explanation.surface: A bird with no tail flies from South Africa to a Mediterranean island.
explanation.definitionFit: Ibiza is one of the Balearic Islands in the western Mediterranean.

clue.text: Old relative with notice on a car in Spanish city

parts.note: gran, short for grandmother, is an older relative
an ad is a notice or advertisement

explanation.surface: Grandma advertises a car in a Spanish city.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ford Granada was a large British family car; Granada is also the Andalusian city of the Alhambra.
explanation.definitionFit: Granada is an Andalusian city and also a Ford saloon model sold in Britain.

clue.text: Wander around town in north Lancashire

indicators.note: around suggests the letters of wander being moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: An invitation to stroll about a Lancashire town.
explanation.definitionFit: Darwen is a mill town in Lancashire, near Blackburn.

clue.text: The same skirt on account, back in the Windward Islands

parts.note: DO is short for ditto, meaning the same
a mini is a short skirt

indicators.note: back says the abbreviation for account is turned round

explanation.surface: A matching miniskirt bought on credit, somewhere in the Caribbean.
explanation.definitionFit: Dominica is an island nation forming part of the Windward group in the Lesser Antilles.

clue.text: European republic suggesting bird on the continent

indicators.note: suggesting says the phrase only sounds like the answer when spoken

parts.note: a crow is a bird and Asia a continent

explanation.surface: A country whose name hints at a bird living on the mainland.
explanation.definitionFit: Croatia is a republic in south-eastern Europe on the Adriatic coast.

clue.text: Rebuilt Abercarn as Australian city

indicators.note: rebuilt says the letters of the Welsh place name are reconstructed in another order

explanation.surface: A Welsh village is reconstructed as a city in Australia.
explanation.walkthrough: Abercarn is a village in south Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Canberra is the capital city of Australia.

clue.text: A sign's returned to a capital in Africa

indicators.note: returned says the plural zodiac sign is read backwards

parts.note: the Ram is the zodiac sign Aries, and the 's makes it plural, rams

explanation.surface: A zodiac sign travels back to an African capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Asmara is the capital city of Eritrea in the Horn of Africa.

clue.text: Try Mass out on the Scilly Isles

indicators.note: out says the letters of the two words are put out of order

explanation.surface: An invitation to attend a church service on the Scillies.
explanation.walkthrough: The Isles of Scilly lie off Cornwall; St Mary's is the largest.
explanation.definitionFit: St Mary's is the largest and most populous island of the Isles of Scilly off Cornwall.

clue.text: Lake at the heart of the sequence

indicators.note: at the heart of keeps only the middle of the synonym for sequence, dropping its outer letters

parts.note: a sequence is a series

explanation.surface: A lake sits at the centre of a chain of events.
explanation.definitionFit: Erie is one of the five Great Lakes of North America.

clue.text: Area of England strangely against ale

indicators.note: strangely says the letters of the two words that follow are arranged oddly

explanation.surface: Some part of England has a peculiar dislike of beer.
explanation.definitionFit: East Anglia is the eastern region of England covering Norfolk, Suffolk and parts of Cambridgeshire.

clue.text: Counterfeit name in plain North Wales resort

indicators.note: in says the fake and the abbreviation go inside the flat land

parts.note: a llano is a grassy plain in Spanish America
a dud is something fake or counterfeit

explanation.surface: A forged name appears plainly at a Welsh seaside town.
explanation.definitionFit: Llandudno is a Victorian seaside resort on the north Wales coast.

clue.text: Sussex port with parking on flat — odd! — yes!

parts.note: even means flat or level

indicators.note: odd says the letters of yes are oddly arranged

explanation.surface: An exclamation about a port with a car park on level ground.
explanation.walkthrough: Pevensey is where William the Conqueror landed in 1066.
explanation.definitionFit: Pevensey is a village and former port on the East Sussex coast.

clue.text: Anti-Rommel broadcast from the home of nougat

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered, so the letters of the phrase are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: Wartime propaganda against Rommel is transmitted from a French sweet-making town.
explanation.walkthrough: Rommel was the German field marshal of the Second World War.
explanation.definitionFit: Montelimar in southern France is famous for producing nougat.

clue.text: Speaks indistinctly in the Swansea area

explanation.surface: Someone is talking unclearly around Swansea.
explanation.walkthrough: The Mumbles is a headland and district on Swansea Bay in south Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: To mutter unclearly is to mumble; Mumbles is a seaside district on Swansea Bay.

clue.text: Script for Isle — of Man?

explanation.surface: A writing system offered for the Isle of Man.
explanation.walkthrough: Java is a programming language (and JavaScript a scripting one); it is also an Indonesian island, where the fossil 'Java Man' was found. The surface suggests the Isle of Man.
explanation.definitionFit: Java names a computer programming language and an Indonesian island where early human fossils called Java Man were unearthed.

clue.text: Gold streak in European country

parts.note: AU is the chemical symbol for gold
a stria is a thin streak or groove

explanation.surface: A vein of gold runs through a European land.
explanation.definitionFit: Austria is a landlocked country in central Europe.

clue.text: Odd sections of tallest arches missing in region of France

indicators.note: odd sections of names the first, third and following letters of the words that follow
missing says those odd letters are dropped, leaving the even ones

explanation.surface: Tall arches with alternate parts gone, somewhere in France.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing the odd letters of 'tallest arches' leaves the even ones.
explanation.definitionFit: Alsace is a region of north-eastern France bordering Germany.

clue.text: Heartless chairmen out to do German in Bedwas's neighbour

indicators.note: out signals the remaining letters being put out of order
heartless says the two central letters of the word chairmen are removed

explanation.surface: Chairmen without spirit are ousted to make way for a German in a Welsh village.
explanation.walkthrough: Machen is German for 'to do' or 'to make', and also a village beside Bedwas near Caerphilly in south Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: The German verb meaning to make or do, and also a Caerphilly village adjoining Bedwas.

clue.text: Feature article on Asian country

parts.note: the chin is a facial feature
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A news feature about an Asian nation.
explanation.definitionFit: China is the populous East Asian country.

clue.text: A duke has a bike-ride round islands in the Aegean

indicators.note: round says the verb meaning goes by bike surrounds the other letters

parts.note: someone who has a bike ride cycles

explanation.surface: A nobleman pedals around some Greek islands.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cyclades are a Greek island group in the Aegean Sea, including Naxos and Mykonos.

clue.text: Upset doorman, ejected some in town in Thuringia

indicators.note: upset in a down clue turns the letters upside down
some says only part of the words is taken

explanation.surface: An angry doorman threw some people out of a German town.
explanation.walkthrough: The run ANEJ, within doorman, ejected, reads upward to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Jena is a university town in the German state of Thuringia.

clue.text: Sly look around popular thoroughfare in province in Ireland

indicators.note: around says the sly look encloses the other pieces

parts.note: a leer is a sly or lascivious look
in means popular or fashionable
ST is short for street, a thoroughfare

explanation.surface: Someone eyes a busy high street in an Irish province.
explanation.definitionFit: Leinster is one of the four traditional provinces of Ireland, containing Dublin.

clue.text: Frightful coward at Scottish castle

indicators.note: frightful suggests the word coward is dreadfully mangled

explanation.surface: A terrified coward is found at a Scottish castle.
explanation.walkthrough: Cawdor Castle near Nairn is linked with Macbeth, Thane of Cawdor.
explanation.definitionFit: Cawdor Castle is a historic castle near Nairn in the Scottish Highlands.

clue.text: Terrier from estate near Haverfordwest — leash may require attention

indicators.note: require attention suggests the letters of the following words need fixing into another order

explanation.surface: Walking a dog near a Welsh town, the lead might need sorting out.
explanation.walkthrough: The breed was developed on the Sealyham estate in Pembrokeshire, Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sealyham terrier is a small white Welsh dog breed named after the estate where it was bred.

clue.text: Over an' out in city in Italy

indicators.note: out signals the letters of the radio phrase being put out of place

explanation.surface: Radio sign-off talk heard in an Italian city.
explanation.walkthrough: "Over and out" ends a radio exchange; here only 'over an'' is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Verona is a city in the Veneto region of northern Italy, setting of Romeo and Juliet.
